Source after Watcher Path D: ingest-watch-daily (not .monitoring-es-* for these charts).

    ingest_bytes = max(0, max_primary_store[day] - max_primary_store[day-1])

React KPI -> Metric Sum ingest_bytes, filter scope:cluster
React daily chart -> Bar date histogram @timestamp 1d, filter scope:cluster
React stacked family -> stacked bar + stream_family, filter scope:index
React family share -> donut by stream_family, filter scope:index
React calendar -> heatmap @timestamp 1d x stream_family, filter scope:index
React index table -> table index_name + Sum ingest_bytes, filter scope:index
Hourly chart -> not in Watcher index (daily grain only)

Import order: data-view-ingest-watch-daily.ndjson, lens-visualizations.ndjson, this dashboard.
